description.content:
This retrieves a list of assets.

See available filters below to customize the list of properties returned.

query.description: Filter by asset type (image, notimage, document, other)
To display only main images, set this to true
Filters assets by the created date, starting from the specified date. Use the format yyyy-mm-dd to input the date
Filters assets by the created date, up to the specified date. Use the format yyyy-mm-dd to input the date.
Filter by attachment type (Property, Unit, Tenancy, Transaction)
Page number, between 1 and the total number of pages.
Field to sort the collection by.

description.content:
Arthur Assets API - the assets surface of the Arthur API v2, the UK property management platform from Arthur Online (an Aareon company). Derived operation-for-operation from the provider's public Postman Documenter collection at https://developer.arthuronline.co.uk/. Every request is scoped to an Arthur entity via the mandatory X-EntityID header and authorised with an OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code access token.
